echo "REFRESH_RC=$rr_rc"
if [ "$rr_rc" -ne 0 ]; then
  "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/append-tool-failure.sh" \
    --log "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/execution-issues.md" \
    --site "step8-main-agent-fix" \
    --tool "refresh-run-logs.sh (best-effort pre-push log refresh; finalize-state.sh absent on Python ship path pre-postmerge)" \
    --exit-code "$rr_rc" \
    --category "Tool Failures" \
    --output-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/refresh-run-logs.stderr.log" \
    --redact || true
fi
"$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/git-push.sh"
